name: Snake Plant
blurb: Calm, reliable and nearly unkillable. It thrives when you forget about it.

name: ZZ Plant
blurb: Quiet and low-key. It grows happily in a dim corner with almost no attention.

name: Zebra Haworthia
blurb: Small, stripy and a little odd, and completely safe around pets.

name: Spider Plant
blurb: Easygoing and playful, always sending out little baby plants.

name: Boston Fern
blurb: Loves a routine and a peaceful room. Give it steady care and it thrives.

name: Prayer Plant
blurb: Expressive: its leaves fold up at night. Moody, but rewarding.

name: Monstera
blurb: Big leaves, big personality. It grows fast and takes up space.

name: Jade Plant
blurb: Sturdy and sun-loving. It can live for decades.

name: Parlor Palm
blurb: Gentle and graceful, and happy in low light.

name: Aloe Vera
blurb: Sun-seeking and tough, and useful too.

name: Peperomia
blurb: Compact, glossy and cheerful, and safe for curious pets.

name: Money Tree
blurb: Confident and tree-like, with a braided trunk that makes a statement.
